hints.title: Ones and Zeros Formula
hints.text: Notice that zerosRow[i] = n - onesRow[i] and zerosCol[j] = m - onesCol[j].

hints.title: Algebraic Simplification
hints.text: The difference formula onesRow[i] + onesCol[j] - zerosRow[i] - zerosCol[j] simplifies directly to 2 * onesRow[i] + 2 * onesCol[j] - n - m.

hints.title: Precomputing Row and Column Counts
hints.text: Compute onesRow and onesCol in a single pass over the grid, then evaluate each cell in O(1) arithmetic.

hints.title: Linear Vector Precomputation Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time with respect to the number of cells in the grid.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-counting ones and zeros for every cell independently takes O(m * n * (m + n)) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m + n) space to store row and column counts.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Simplifies the algebraic formula to depend purely on precomputed row and column ones sums.
